correctness.rationale: The identity h*_1=|P∩Z^d|−d−1 (with the affine lattice understood) makes P an empty simplex, and the height model gives volume m=a+3. The subgroup generated by the two tall elements has mean height k(1+1/|J|); averaging each coordinate character shows this cannot exceed k(1+1/m), so J is the whole group. Support is constant on generators of each tall element's cyclic subgroup and is at least 3k. Each distinct opposite pair among those generators must contain a tall element, hence φ(order)≤4 (order two is handled separately). The orders are 2,3,4,5,6,8,10,12; their pairwise lcms are at most 60. Equality in height subadditivity for two low summands of a tall element forbids all individual coordinate carries. The resulting allowable residues must faithfully generate the cyclic character group and must solve the displayed rational height system. Full coefficient rank and augmented inconsistency modulo the stated prime certify rational inconsistency via an invertible square minor; the original C++ implementation matches these conditions. Independently, literal carry tests and Fraction elimination over Q inspected all 34,219 pairs; 2,366 admitted faithful residue sets and 2,352 were inconsistent. The remaining counts by volume are 4:1, 5:4, 6:3, 8:2, 10:4. Exact witness heights were reproduced at each volume. Faithfulness and integer total coordinate sum give the simplex correspondence, and coordinate replication multiplies heights for every k≥2 without changing the group.
residual_risks: The finite exclusion is exhaustive because of the proved cutoff, not because a search past it found no examples. Rational consistency is not an assertion of realizability for every high-element pair.

value.rationale: For the same natural Ehrhart family with unrestricted maximum 12, the full-group cyclic hypothesis has a precise mathematical effect: the maximum falls to 10, volumes 7 and 9 are genuinely missing despite lying below it, and all admitted volumes occur in every allowed exponent. This determines possible Ehrhart coefficients for cyclic simplex constructions rather than just improving a cutoff.
residual_risks: No classification of dimensions, lattice isomorphism classes, or noncyclic groups follows.
